No line of this stanza quotes a verse closely; it is the hymn's own confession.
Cowper printed the hymn under Exodus 10:9. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

“We will go with our young and old,” Moses replied. “We will go with our sons and daughters, and with our flocks and herds, for we must hold a feast to the LORD.” EXODUS 10:9 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ EXODUS 10

Gracious Lord, our children see, By thy mercy we are free; But shall these, alas! remain Subjects still of Satan’s reign? Israel’s young ones, when of old Pharaoh threatened to withhold; Then thy messenger said, “No; Let the children also go.” STANZA I
